title: Seattle · Mount Rainier Sunrise Loop
slogan: A 292 km loop out of Enumclaw fuel
story: Volcano views with serious seasonal checks. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 113 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Sunrise Road, Mount Rainier viewpoint, while Enumclaw fuel and Packwood food keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

sections.advice: This Sunrise Road → Packwood food stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Sunrise Road → Packwood food (13 km) is the reward section in Seattle. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
